name: The Conditioning Closure of Learning Spaces Is the Convex-Geometry Ideal Class
statement: Up to signed-coordinate equivalence and suppression of constants, $\operatorname{Cl}_c(\mathsf{Learn})=\mathsf{Icg}$.
proof: Every conditioning of a learning space is an upper ideal in its surviving orientation. Conversely, if $\mathcal C$ is an upper ideal of a learning space $\mathcal L$, then $(\mathcal L\times\{0\})\cup(\mathcal C\times\{1\})$ is a learning space whose conditioning at the marker value $1$ is $\mathcal C$.
